summary: Knowledge base: the paper detail rail now shows a prominent 所属类别 card (clickable category chips that locate the category, an explicit 未分类 chip, inline 编辑类别), categories left at the default slate colour get distinct graph hues shared by nodes, directory dots, list tags, membership dialog and detail chips, and the detail typography is rebalanced (header rules no longer leak into the notes head: 笔记 was 12px and its buttons 21px). The library list cards no longer inherit a flex row that squeezed dates and tags into narrow columns.
scope_note: Owner-reported UI problems only. Shares the uncommitted worktree with 2026-09-30-project-creation-switcher (docs/HANDOFF.md is edited by both); commit the switcher unit first to review each in isolation.

budget_impact.rationale: Static CSS/JS presentation and deterministic tests only; no model call, prompt, provider or external request added.
budget_impact.before: Zero model tokens on the knowledge-base view.
budget_impact.after: Zero model tokens on the knowledge-base view.

checks.note: Run in the owner's terminal because the agent sandbox blocks localhost binds; includes the node organization UI and project switcher tests.

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; measured computed font sizes and exercised category chips, 未分类, 编辑类别 and graph/library modes in the browser preview, light and dark mode.

open_risks: Graph node saturation cap raised from 14-32% to 20-38% so categories are distinguishable; the owner has not yet judged whether this still fits the ink-on-paper look.
A graph node still takes the colour of only its first category; papers in several categories list all of them in the detail card.
Tapping a graph node does not expand a folded directory category, so the highlighted paper may be hidden in the directory; the detail card still names its categories.
